messages:
Maria Support: FYI opened ticket CS-4821 from ACME — embeddings endpoint returning `dimension mismatch` after they upgraded to our latest model bundle and started batching. Customer says embeddings size toggles between 1024 and 1536 depending on batch size; they hit failures in their downstream indexer. Pasting their error: 

ACME engineer: 
```
  Error: embeddings: incompatible dimension (expected 1536, got 1024)
  at embeddings/validate (embeddings.go:142)
  at api/handler (server.go:321)
  payload: { model: "redwood-embed-large-v2", batch_size: 32 }
```

They only see the error when `batch_size > 1`. With `batch_size=1` everything is fine. They report throughput drop and increased latency when trying to patch client to single-item calls. Can someone take a look? I added request/response logs the customer provided and their minimal repro below.

---

ACME repro (from their support message):
1) Call `/v1/embeddings` with payload: `{ "model":"redwood-embed-large-v2", "inputs": [[...],[...]] }` (2 items)
2) Server returns 500 with the dimension mismatch error above.
3) Repeat with single input -> returns embeddings of length 1536.
---

Ben Escalations: assigning to me. Can you drop the full raw request+response (headers removed) into the thread, Maria? Also, do we have metrics showing any model variant change on that model around that timestamp?

Maria Support: pasted the anonymized request now. Customer is on region us-west-2 and they said the error started after a deploy yesterday evening. I also saw they included `X-Model-Variant: gpu-optim-v2` header in one sample and `X-Model-Variant: quant-1024` in another — not sure if those headers are from their side or some proxy.

Elaine Eng-ML: quick note: embedding vector length is model-dependent; redwood-embed-large-v2 should be 1536. If they sometimes get 1024 that suggests either a fallback to an older model (redwood-embed-base) or we are returning a compressed/quantized representation incorrectly decoded. The batch path differs from single-item path in our runtime (continuous batching + fastpath). Could be an indexing/reshape bug when concatenating batched outputs.

Raj Infra: I pulled infra traces for us-west-2 around the customer's timestamps. There was a canary deploy for the runtime yesterday at 23:40 UTC that touched the batching optimization (router + batcher) but no global rollback. No errors by default in infra logs, but I see request routing flapping between `node-12` and `node-17` for that session which might explain variant switching if those nodes hosted different model variants during the rollout.

Maria Support: customer says they were routed to different hosts (they saw different request ids). I'll ask for request ids for failing + passing calls.

Ben Escalations: useful. Elaine — can you repro locally with a small harness? Try sending a batched payload and inspect per-item dims from the runtime before we encode/send to user. If it's a reshape problem we should see mismatch spot in the batch aggregator.

Elaine Eng-ML: repro progress: I ran a batch harness against `redwood-embed-large-v2` on staging with batch_size=4 and toggled variant headers. When the request is routed to a node with pre-quantized model it returns 1024-length vectors, but our encode step normally tags responses with `embedding_dim` in the response meta. I found two issues: 1) the batcher aggregates per-item outputs but assumes identical dim across items and only emits `embedding_dim` from the first item, 2) when a mixed-variant batch happens (rare but possible during rollout) the output gets concatenated/clipped to the first item's dim. So root cause = mixed-variant routing during transitional deploy + batcher assumption.

Maria Support: that aligns with customer: they had intermittent successes and failures. They also reported throughput spikes when switching to `batch_size=1` — expected. Customer asked for an ETA for fix and wants a short-term runaround.

Ben Escalations: suggested short-term mitigations: 1) recommend client set `batch_size=1` and pin `X-Model-Variant` to a stable variant (e.g., `gpu-optim-v2`) while we fix runtime, 2) add a server-side detection to reject mixed-variant batched requests with a clear 409-ish error and message, 3) prioritize fix to batcher to validate per-item dims before aggregate. Which of these can we ship quickly?

Elaine Eng-ML: quick wins: we can add a server-side pre-check to the batcher to validate `embedding_dim` metadata for each item and reject with `400`/`409` before encoding — small patch, low risk. Full fix (ensure proper per-item padding/consistent upcasting) will take a couple days + QA. I can prepare the pre-check PR and a runbook for support to reference.

Kyle Docs: I'll draft a short FAQ blurb and add a runbook snippet to the embeddings docs. Proposed FAQ entry: "Why do I get embedding dimension mismatch errors on batched requests?" -> Explain mixed-variant routing during deploys, advise client-side pinning of model variant or single-item batches, and link to runbook. Will also include example error and suggested client fallback logic.

Maria Support: customer wants a rollback if we can't give ETA. Do we have a rollback window? Raj?

Raj Infra: we can roll back the canary to last known-stable for the runtime in that region within ~30 minutes. But that will impact other customers using the new batching optimization. I'll hold until we have an agreed plan; if ACME is high priority we can rollback.

Ben Escalations: decision: propose to ACME to set `batch_size=1` and pin variant now, and offer an SLA credit or priority patch if they still want rollback. Maria, please send them a short triage note with the mitigation and ETA for the pre-check patch (ETA: ~24 hours to deploy to staging + 48 hours to prod pending QA).

Maria Support: sending customer note now (snippet I sent):
> Thanks — we've identified a mixed-variant routing problem that can cause batched requests to return inconsistent embedding dims. Short-term workaround: set `batch_size=1` and pin `X-Model-Variant: gpu-optim-v2`. We're preparing a low-risk server-side validation to reject mixed-variant batched requests within 24 hours; full fix in ~72 hours. If you prefer we can rollback the canary — would you like us to proceed?

Customer replied (pasted in): "Please do the mitigation first. We'll switch to single-item calls tonight and monitor. If we see degradation we'll ask for rollback."

Kyle Docs: created draft runbook section (internal link): `docs/embeddings/runbooks/mixed_variant_batching.md` (internal) — includes the pre-check snippet and example error responses. Here's the pre-check snippet I propose for the runbook:
```
# server-side batch validation (pseudo)
for item in batch.items:
  if item.meta.embedding_dim != batch.items[0].meta.embedding_dim:
    return 409, { "error": "mixed_model_variant_in_batch", "message": "Batch contains items with mismatched embedding dims. Retry with single-item requests or pin model variant." }
```

Kyle Docs: also adding an FAQ entry and a customer-facing short explanation we can paste into support replies. Will mark the doc as internal-first until the runtime fix ships.

Elaine Eng-ML: I'll open PR for the quick pre-check now and tag @ben_escalations for review. Also adding unit tests for mixed-variant detection. PR will include a server log line: `WARN batch validation: mixed variant detected, batch_id=...` so support can find failures in logs quickly.

deploy-bot: Build #8201 for repo redwood-runtime passed on staging (tag: batcher-precheck).

Raj Infra: scheduling a canary deploy of the pre-check to us-west-2 staging at 02:30 UTC. If staging metrics are clean we'll roll to prod with a small canary subset.

Ben Escalations: good. Action items capture: 
- Maria: send mitigation + ask for request ids (done).
- ACME: set `batch_size=1` + pin variant (they accepted).
- Elaine: PR for batcher pre-check (ETA 24h).
- Raj: staging canary + plan for rollback if needed.
- Kyle: update docs/FAQ and paste customer-friendly blurb for support reply.

Maria Support: closing loop to customer: they said they'll switch tonight and will reopen if they see issues. I'll follow up after patch. Thanks team :thumbsup:

Ben Escalations: once PR lands, post the prod deploy time here and I'll coordinate outreach to affected customers and update the public FAQ. Also let's add a monitoring alert: if we see `mixed_model_variant_in_batch` count > 5 in 5m in any region -> page eng-ml.

Kyle Docs: will add the FAQ entry under "Embeddings > Troubleshooting" and include suggested support templates. I'll also add an entry in CHANGELOG for runtime behavior change when we ship the fix.

Elaine Eng-ML: quick follow-up note: long-term we should change the batcher to enforce variant affinity for items that share a single request (i.e., route batched items to same variant) or gracefully upcast lower-dim outputs. I'll put this as a follow-up task in the eng-ml backlog.

Maria Support: thanks all. I logged the customer-facing note in CS-4821 and set follow-up for 48 hours.

Ben Escalations: thanks. Closing thread when pre-check is live in prod.
